note: Framework-neutral risk -> control -> evidence map for Numina Labs. Import by hand into Probo (Risks, Controls, Measures/Evidence) or Comp AI CE (Risks, Controls, Evidence). Evidence paths are relative to the repo root; anything under local/compliance/data/ is gitignored and stays on Sam's machine.

risks.title: Doing business with a sanctioned person, entity or jurisdiction
Unknown or misidentified counterparty or beneficial owner
Payments used to launder funds (structuring, pass-through, third-party payers)
Offering or customer falls into Stripe prohibited/restricted categories
Exposure of identity data or signing keys
Launching a financial service without counsel review

controls.title: Screen entity, DBA, control person and every 25%+ owner against OFAC SDN + consolidated lists (Watchman, fallback built-in)
Human cross-check in OFAC Sanctions List Search, recorded per party
Lists refreshed at most 7 days before a screen; sha256 + publication date recorded
Block comprehensively sanctioned / Stripe-prohibited jurisdictions; FATF call-for-action list flagged
KYC intake validated against schema (last-4 only, street address, age, unknown fields rejected)
Beneficial owners of 25%+ and a control person collected and screened
Identity verification through a licensed IDV provider (not yet contracted)
Nothing approved or cleared without Sam Kott's Ed25519 sign-off (SKOTT34-Ed25519) verified against the committed public key
Rule-based monitoring of Stripe payment exports (structuring, velocity, round amounts, jurisdictions, churn, payer mismatch, rapid in-out, fan-in, geography, dormancy)
Every alert reviewed, noted and decided by Sam; escalation to counsel; no tipping off
Offering text scanned for Stripe prohibited/restricted categories; source re-checked every 180 days
Case records encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM, key from NUMINA_COMPLIANCE_KEY)
No PII, lists or private keys in git; module isolated from src/ and the Worker build
Attorney review before any financial service launch (PENDING, follow-up due 2026-12-09)
